title: Docs: Usage Insights export reports (CSV/JSON schema, limits, audit logging, troubleshooting)
author: Wei Chen
body: Summary This PR adds customer-facing documentation for Usage Insights export reports, including CSV/JSON schemas, size/time-range limits, audit logging behavior, and a troubleshooting/FAQ section focused on common support issues (invoice mismatch, Unknown route, export timeouts, missing model breakdown). This is intended to be the canonical reference linked from the Console export modal and Support macros. Context The new in-console “usage insights” feature includes an Export action that generates bounded reports (CSV + JSON) for finance/ops workflows. Beta feedback + recent support tickets highlighted confusion around schema stability, cached token fields, and reconciliation with invoices. Related: ENG-8425 (export job + download), ENG-8428 (RBAC + audit), ENG-8431 (docs), SUP-18458 (timeouts), SUP-18475 (audit logs), INT-927 (cached tokens interpretation). What’s included New docs page: Usage Insights → Export reports • How exports work (job creation, processing, download, expiration) • Supported formats: CSV and JSON • CSV schema reference (field definitions, units, nullable behavior) • JSON schema reference (mirrors CSV fields + metadata) • Limits and guardrails: max time range, max rows, max file size, rate limits, retention/expiry • Audit logging: events emitted on export creation and download, fields captured, how to find them • RBAC/scoping: org/project boundary rules, what happens if user loses access while a job is running • Schema versioning policy: additive changes only during GA; deprecation/announcement policy for renames/removals New troubleshooting section • “Why doesn’t my export total match my invoice?” (timing, late-arriving metering, rounding, taxes/credits, retention window differences) • “Unknown route is dominating” (missing tagging, SDK/gateway defaults, route normalization/capping) • “Export failed / timeout” (reduce time range, filter by env/region, use pagination by day, retry behavior) • “Model breakdown columns are empty” (fallback/multi-model attribution details + minimum-volume suppression where applicable) • “Cached token cost looks wrong” (definition of cached_input_tokens / cached_output_tokens, how unit cost is applied) Docs structure / navigation • Usage Insights landing page now links to Export reports and Route tagging guide (PR-812). • Console UI text references match the export modal labels (Format, Time range, Filters, Include hourly breakdown). CSV schema (as documented) The CSV export uses one row per (time_bucket, route, model_variant, region, deployment_mode) aggregation. All token fields represent metered tokens (post-normalization). Costs are USD unless otherwise specified by contract. Columns: • report_id: string UUID for the export job • generated_at: RFC3339 timestamp • time_start, time_end: RFC3339 timestamps (requested window) • time_bucket_start: RFC3339 timestamp (bucket boundary; hourly or daily) • org_id, project_id: Redwood IDs • environment: string (prod|staging|dev) • region: string (e.g., us-east-1) • deployment_mode: string (hosted|dedicated|private) • route: string (normalized route identifier; may be “unknown”) • route_source: string (sdk|gateway|unknown) • model: string (requested model family) • model_variant: string (actual served variant; may differ due to fallback) • requests: integer count • input_tokens, output_tokens: integers • cached_input_tokens, cached_output_tokens: integers (subset of input/output tokens served from cache) • billable_input_tokens, billable_output_tokens: integers (tokens used for billing; may differ from raw tokens depending on plan) • gpu_time_ms: integer (if available; empty otherwise) • cost_total_usd: decimal string • unit_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: decimal string (derived) • latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms: integers • error_rate: decimal string in [0,1] Notes: Some columns are empty depending on deployment_mode and telemetry availability (e.g., gpu_time_ms in Private). JSON export (as documented) The JSON file contains: • metadata: report_id, generated_at, filters, schema_version • rows: array of objects with the same fields as CSV rows Schema version is a string like “2026-04-usage-insights-export-v1”. Limits (as documented; matches backend guardrails) • Maximum requested window: 31 days for hourly exports; 90 days for daily exports • Maximum rows: 250,000 • Maximum file size: 200 MB (compressed server-side; client sees uncompressed CSV/JSON) • Jobs expire: 7 days after generation (download link returns 404 after expiry) • Rate limits: export creation 10/min/org; download 60/min/org (subject to change) Audit logging (as documented) Export actions are audit logged for compliance evidence. Events: • usage_insights.export.created (when a user requests an export) • usage_insights.export.downloaded (when a user downloads the generated file) Fields captured include: actor_user_id, actor_email, org_id, project_id, report_id, format, time_start/time_end, applied_filters (env/region/deployment_mode/route/model), ip_address, user_agent, and outcome (success|denied|error). RBAC: If a user lacks access to the project at creation time, export creation is denied. If access is revoked after creation, downloading is denied and the audit event records outcome=denied. Copy edits / consistency • Align terminology with Console: “Export report” (not “download CSV”), “time bucket”, “deployment mode”. • Add explicit disclaimer: exports are for operational insight and may not equal invoice totals due to billing adjustments and timing. • Add link to route tagging guide and cardinality best practices. Screenshots • Adds one screenshot placeholder (staging console) showing the Export modal; will be replaced before GA by Connor O’Brien per release checklist. Files changed (high level) • docs/usage-insights/export-reports.mdx (new) • docs/usage-insights/troubleshooting.mdx (new) • docs/usage-insights/index.mdx (update links) • docs/partials/audit-logging-exports.mdx (new partial) • docs/partials/export-limits.mdx (new partial) • scripts/link-check-ignore.txt (update for new anchors) • static/images/console/usage-insights-export-modal.png (placeholder) • changelog/console/2026-04-usage-insights-export-docs.md (docs release note) Commits 1) docs(usage-insights): add export reports page with CSV/JSON schema 2) docs(usage-insights): add troubleshooting + invoice mismatch FAQ 3) docs(security): document export audit logging events and RBAC behavior 4) chore(site): nav + link check updates 5) docs: add export limits + schema versioning policy Testing • Preview build (docs site) • Link checker • Spellcheck CI Status ✅ build-and-test ✅ lint ✅ link-check ✅ spellcheck Review notes / follow-ups • Kevin: requested explicit list of audit event fields and deny semantics (addressed). • Dev: asked to include support-friendly guidance for timeouts + “Unknown route” (addressed). • Monica: requested alignment with SDK parameter name “route” and header behavior (linked to tagging guide; no API changes in this PR).
